dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Ah, my wondrous heroes! Would you be game for a few more rounds of Fungus Mechanicus?

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: And should you have any questions, feel free to ask away!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! If you hadn't mentioned it, Paimon would've totally forgotten! During the first tournament, we were attracted by the big...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *cough* Err, we were attracted by the big tournament, which also had a sweet prize!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that means that we'll also have to prepare a tidy sum for the next tournament, won't we? That way, we can motivate people to aim for the top, which is where the best prizes will be!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll also have to rent the venue, hire staff... And all this stuff's gonna cost Mora... Are we really gonna have to fork over all eight figures of it?

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: Haha, and now you're speaking my language!

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: Not to worry. I will be on the hunt for sponsors in the lead-up to the next tournament. We're talking about something along the lines of several dozen merchants helping to put up the funds for it to be held.

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: As for remuneration, we'll just have to provide them with the equivalent amount of "exposure." After all, many merchants place great emphasis on the advertisement potential that popular competitive events have!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That does sound pretty reasonable. If things go well, raising funds this way means that everyone wins!

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: This field of work can be considered my specialty. Just give the okay, and I'll start sponsor-hunting.

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: Of course, I'll investigate the status of all our sponsors very carefully before organizing it into a chart for your perusal.

choices.text: We will indeed have to be quite selective.

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: Understood. Vigilance will be the watchword — especially after what happened the last time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll be counting on you then, Balfour!

choices.text: We'll definitely have to weed out any people with ill intent.
We can leave it for later.

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: Alright! See you later, then, great heroes!
